name: vat-check
description: EU VAT checks and dated logs

interface.shortDescription: EU VAT checks and dated logs
interface.longDescription:
Run a VAT number check for EU tax identifiers in VIES and get a dated XLSX validation log.

Check up to 100 business VAT numbers against the published number structures, then query the live validation service. See valid, invalid, unavailable or error for each input, with the reason and consultation time. Registered names and addresses appear when the member state publishes them. Add your own VAT number to request consultation numbers.

Keep input order, mark duplicates, filter and sort results, check service status and re-check unavailable numbers. Download dated XLSX and CSV logs for your invoice and audit files; links expire in about an hour.

Limits: covers the 27 EU member states and Northern Ireland (XI). A validation reflects the member state database at consultation time; invalid means not valid for cross-border transactions on that day. Some member states do not return names or addresses. Structure checks apply no national check-digit algorithm. Unavailable means retry later. This is not tax advice and does not decide whether reverse charge applies.

positive.expected_behavior: Shows overall VIES availability, member-state service status and source retrieval time.

positive.prompt: VIES VAT validation for DE811907980 and ESA28015865
positive.expected_behavior: Shows live validation outcomes and consultation times, with empty registered fields when the member state does not publish names or addresses.

positive.prompt: Bulk VAT number check: 6388047V and IE6388047V, default country IE
positive.expected_behavior: Preserves input order and duplicate rows with a shared live consultation.

positive.prompt: VIES VAT validation for ATU33864707 using my requester VAT IE6388047V
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the consultation number when VIES accepts the requester and includes it in the validation log.

pl-PL.subtitle: Sprawdzanie numerów VAT
pl-PL.description: Sprawdź do 100 numerów VAT z UE i Irlandii Północnej w usłudze VIES. Pobierz datowane raporty XLSX i CSV. Wynik zależy od chwili sprawdzenia; brak dostępności oznacza ponowienie próby. Bez porad podatkowych.

de-DE.subtitle: EU-USt-Nummern prüfen
de-DE.description: Prüfen Sie bis zu 100 Umsatzsteuer-IDs aus der EU und Nordirland in VIES. Laden Sie datierte XLSX- und CSV-Protokolle herunter. Ergebnisse gelten zum Abfragezeitpunkt. Bei Nichtverfügbarkeit später erneut prüfen. Keine Steuerberatung.

es-ES.subtitle: Comprobar números de IVA
es-ES.description: Compruebe hasta 100 números de IVA de la UE e Irlanda del Norte en VIES. Descargue registros fechados en XLSX y CSV. El resultado corresponde al momento de consulta; si no está disponible, inténtelo más tarde. No ofrece asesoramiento fiscal.

fr-FR.subtitle: Vérifier les numéros de TVA
fr-FR.description: Vérifiez jusqu’à 100 numéros de TVA de l’UE et d’Irlande du Nord dans VIES. Téléchargez des journaux datés XLSX et CSV. Le résultat reflète le moment de la consultation ; réessayez en cas d’indisponibilité. Aucun conseil fiscal.

ja-JP.subtitle: EU VAT番号を確認
ja-JP.description: EUと北アイルランドのVAT番号を最大100件、VIESで確認します。日付付きXLSX・CSVログをダウンロードできます。結果は照会時点の情報です。利用不可の場合は後で再試行してください。税務助言は行いません。

pt-BR.subtitle: Verificar números de IVA
pt-BR.description: Verifique até 100 números de IVA da UE e Irlanda do Norte no VIES. Baixe registros datados em XLSX e CSV. O resultado corresponde ao momento da consulta; se indisponível, tente mais tarde. Não oferece aconselhamento tributário.
